replication.target_description: Replication report located, but supplied description names both sharing discernment and false-headline sharing; p.5 locator cannot be resolved to a unique test in the unpaginated canonical text. Candidate tests are pooled Stage 2 discernment interaction, discernment between-group t test, and false-headline sharing between-group t test.

reported_success.quote: Our findings are thus in partial agreement with those of the target study

notes: Identity assessment: supplied text title exactly matches the replication reference. Supplemental-material attribution names Jon Roozenbeek, Alexandra L. J. Freeman and Sander van der Linden, and its identifier and supplemental URL identify DOI 10.1177/09567976211024535. The document contains Method, Results, Discussion and Conclusion, author contributions and references: a primary replication report, not an abstract or preregistration. No supplied PDF; canonical text has no printed page boundaries. Original side and replication n/p are unassigned placeholders, not findings of absence. No unique effect selected because the neutral description explicitly covers multiple outcomes and tests. Printed candidates, kept separately with same-test p: pooled Stage 2 headline-veracity by treatment regression β = 0.015, F(3, 47490) = 4.52, p = .017 (ivreg2); alternative reghdfe model β = 0.015, p = .026. Pooled discernment between-group t test d = −0.10, t(1581) = −2.013, p = .044; false-headline sharing between-group t test d = 0.11, t(1581) = 2.113, p = .035. Stage 2 within-treatment discernment d = −0.14 and within-control d = −0.10 are different contrasts, not an intervention d for the regression interaction. No conversion or standardisation inferred. Authors describe Stage 1 as unsuccessful and pooled Stage 2 as replicating the treatment effect with attenuation; their overall narrative says partial agreement, coded mixed. No analytic N derived.
